title: Two-door airlock mutual-exclusion interlock
nl_spec: An airlock has two doors, A and B. For containment, the two doors must NEVER be open at the same time. Each door has an open command (OpenA_Cmd, OpenB_Cmd). A door opens only while its open command is held AND the other door is currently closed; otherwise it stays closed. If both doors are commanded open simultaneously, door A has priority and door B stays closed. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named airlock with inputs OpenA_Cmd, OpenB_Cmd and outputs DoorA, DoorB (TRUE = open).

safety_properties.nl: The two doors are never open at the same time (containment).
Door A is open only while its open command is held.
Door B is open only while its open command is held.

scenarios.description: A opens, B blocked while A open

notes: Classic mutual-exclusion safety interlock. Reference evaluates door A first, then gates door B on the freshly-updated DoorA, guaranteeing exclusion within a scan.
